findings.reason: §3's repair scope is set by §2's verdict, so the plan must say which solve produces Reached before a node can report one.
findings.text: §2(1) states the fractions to run in the order "1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32 and 1/64" and then requires "each solve started from the last state that qualified, beginning at §1's positive control", while §2(3) defines Reached as the full recorded displacement qualifying "at the end of the sequence": read in the written order the full-displacement solve is tried first and directly from the positive control (the same shape as §1's refused lower response perturbation, only under the loosened policy), and read in the order the chaining rule forces it is tried last from an already-displaced qualified state; those are different solves, so the record's largest-qualifying fraction, smallest-failing fraction and Reached verdict all differ by the reading

response_events.note: The sequence is now stated in the order it is run, smallest fraction first and doubling to the full displacement, each solve started from the last state that qualified; Reached is the final solve of that sequence qualifying.
